mathematical_review.maximal_exponent: The decomposition is x=Δ^p A(x), where p=p(x) is the maximal integer with Δ^p≼_L x; A(x)=Δ^(−p)x is positive and Δ is not a left divisor of A(x). The pair (p,A) is unique. p may be negative, so a diagram must not imply a positive Δ exponent.
mathematical_review.factor_order_and_gcd: The greedy recursion starts with A_0=A(x), takes a_i=Δ∧_L A_(i−1) as the leftmost factor, and writes A_(i−1)=a_i A_i. Thus A(x)=a_1 a_2 … a_r in that order. Equivalently, each condition in (c) is a_i=Δ∧_L(a_i a_(i+1)…a_r). Here ∧_L is the greatest common left divisor; it is not a right gcd.
mathematical_review.simple_factors_and_weighting: For nonempty residual tails, each a_i is a proper simple positive braid: 1≺_L a_i≺_L Δ. The condition says the factor is the full left gcd of Δ and its entire remaining tail. The adjacent consequence is (a_i a_(i+1))∧_L Δ=a_i for i<r. In the empty case r=0, there are no factors and x=Δ^p.
mathematical_review.uniqueness_and_delta_convention: Uniqueness first fixes (p,A(x)) by maximality, then deterministically fixes a_1 as Δ∧_L A(x); left cancellation and induction fix the remaining factors. Δ denotes the half twist throughout; Δ² is the full twist and must not replace Δ in the exponent or gcd criterion.
mathematical_review.geometric_braid_reading: The theorem gives abstract positive braid factors and their left divisibility relations; it specifies no particular Artin words, crossings, or endpoint permutation for the generic a_i. A generic factor-chain diagram should therefore not invent a strand drawing or crossing data.

diagram_recommendation.content: Use a compact algebraic schematic with the decomposition x=Δ^p·A, the maximal-exponent condition on A, and a left-to-right product a_1 a_2 … a_r. Under the factor chain, show the successive residual tails A_(i−1)=a_i…a_r and label a_i=Δ∧_L A_(i−1), with the unique positive quotient A_i after removing the leftmost factor. Mark each a_i as proper simple (1≺_L a_i≺_LΔ), and optionally show adjacent left-weighting (a_i a_(i+1))∧_LΔ=a_i. Include the r=0 case as x=Δ^p. Keep p as an arbitrary integer, explicitly distinguish the half twist Δ from Δ², and label the order/gcd as left. Do not draw unspecified crossings or assert geometric data for the factors.
